author: in2forex
text:
DrummerBoy wrote: Decided to work a bit harder today, so i am submitting my second assignment:) I heard some people mentioning minor DBR/RBD. What is the minor DBR/RBD? How do we distinguish this from a "normal" zone?

Hi DrummerBoy

I'll try give an explanation based on how I see things. On any chart we have many DBR's and RBD's, some are large and can extend over time, and in these we often find smaller ones. The following chart demonstrates what I mean. See over time how price has ranged up, based out and then dropped down forming a large RBD

But within that large RBD we can see another smaller RBD, and if we went to a LTF we would find more.

So often within a chart we see a combination of smaller RBD/DBR which when combined form a larger one. I'm not sure if this is what was referred to as "minor" / "major" as asked in your question.

In the third chart I have just added some other RBD and DBR that I see in the chart for reference. Please remember I'm also learning, but this is my current understanding of RBD & DBR
